scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.debug: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,blue "npm run debug --prefix backend" "npm run debug --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run bundle --prefix backend
scripts.package: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$distFiles = Get-ChildItem ./backend/dist -Filter '*.js' -Depth 0; if ($distFiles) { Write-Host '✅ Build ready for deployment:'; $distFiles | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  - ' + $_.Name + ' (' + [math]::Round($_.Length / 1MB, 2) + ' MB)') } } else { Write-Host '❌ No bundle found. Run build:prod first.' }"
